# Autarki

> The buyer pays you, and you keep the keys. Autarki is the wallet and the shop.

Autarki is in beta. It runs on your computer. A 64-bit Android phone can install its own copy. A phone on the same network can still open your computer's page. This website stores nothing and does not take an order. Pay with XBT or Pay with BTC. XBT is named first.

## Pages

- [Home](https://autarki.app/index.md): No platform. Just the sale. The buyer pays you, and you keep the keys.
- [Notice board](https://autarki.app/notice-board.md): A wallet publishes the stall. This page reads the relay, stores nothing, and does not take an order. A description that starts with Available only on Autarki; is left off.
- [Wallet](https://autarki.app/wallet.md): You hold the 24 words. Lightning is built in on AMD and Intel. The Autarki LSP is one channel that can pay later shops.
- [Shop](https://autarki.app/shop.md): The shop runs on your computer. The stall is public. The order is private. Autarki does not take a cut of the catalog price. Lightning has a routing fee and a room fee.
- [Classifieds](https://autarki.app/classifieds.md): Ship pays with Lightning. With a float, the coins sit on the seller's node until Mark received. The named referee decides and does not hold the coins. This page can publish a note a Nostr extension signs. The form has the same place, image, and map fields as the app. Category comes first. Offer and Hire appear only for a job. A hire carries no payment code. Goods, a service, or a rental with a price above zero names the shipment. A giveaway can name images. A personal does not. Preview this ad shows the note on this page and does not publish it. Show this ad on other markets posts a second note with no price. The sale stays on the relay this board reads. The board terms are accepted before the first note.
- [Mining](https://autarki.app/mining.md): Paste a RouteHash token, then click Mine XBT or Mine BTC. The next reward address is your wallet's. Nothing is spent until Mine.
- [Install](https://autarki.app/install.md): Install Autarki on your computer. AMD and Intel include Lightning. A Raspberry Pi leaves Lightning off. A 64-bit Android phone can install its own copy. An iPhone can join the public TestFlight test.
- [Privacy](https://autarki.app/privacy.md): The 24 words stay on your device. The camera scans a code. Location fills the shop. The page talks to relays and nodes.
- [Board rules](https://autarki.app/board.md): Rules for a public shop note and a classified. Child sexual content is forbidden. A report does not remove the ad.
- [Support](https://autarki.app/support.md): Help with Autarki is in Discord #autarki. This site does not sign in and cannot recover the 24 words.
- [Another node](https://autarki.app/channel.md): Incoming room for a Lightning node that is not the Autarki page in front of you. Blake2b XBT, then SHA-256 BTC. The price is sats. This page does not take the fee. A bare fee does not name the node.

## Optional

- [Download 0.1.0](https://github.com/RouteHash-com/autarki/releases/tag/0.1.0): The public download. Check SHA256SUMS from that same release.
- [Android 0.1.0](https://github.com/RouteHash-com/autarki/releases/download/0.1.0/autarki-android.apk): Version 0.1.0 (17). Lightning for Blake2b XBT bitcoin and SHA-256 BTC bitcoin is in this package. Download for a 64-bit Android phone. Allow the phone to install it. This file installs over the previous signed 0.1.0 package. A phone that already has 0.1.0 (1) has to uninstall that copy first. Request access at https://appdistribution.firebase.dev/i/2ae8a6c81ce866a4.
- [iPhone 0.1.0](https://testflight.apple.com/join/2WMBzSpM): Version 0.1.0, build 4. This build does not start Lightning. It is not on the App Store. Join the public TestFlight test.
- [Source](https://github.com/RouteHash-com/autarki): The Autarki repository.
- [Umbrel community store](https://github.com/RouteHash-com/umbrel-store): The RouteHash community store. It is not the official Umbrel App Store.
- [Discord #autarki](https://discord.gg/VBxvzQXvt): Bug reports.
- [routehash.com](https://routehash.com): The mining site. The hire happens in the wallet.
